line.en: the oslo band luna horns plays the lillesalen hall at 19:00, on tour with their debut album afro space hotel. a six-piece horn group, booking open.
line.de: die oslo-band luna horns spielt um 19 uhr im lillesalen, auf tour mit ihrem debütalbum afro space hotel. eine sechsköpfige bläsergruppe, buchung offen.
line.tr: oslo'lu grup luna horns, saat 19:00'da lillesalen salonunda çalıyor; ilk albümleri afro space hotel ile turne. altı kişilik üfleme grubu, rezervasyon açık.

sparks.why: Luna Horns at Kulturhuset i Bergen, Lillesalen, Sat 5 Dec 2026 19:00, per Fjord Norway and Visit Bergen listings; address Vaskerelven 8.

line.en: the lystgården christmas market is open saturday 12:00 to 16:00, a small local market. the listing shows this day only, so check before you go.
line.de: der julemarkt am lystgården ist samstag von 12 bis 16 uhr offen, ein kleiner lokaler markt. die anzeige nennt nur diesen tag, bitte vorher prüfen.
line.tr: lystgården noel pazarı cumartesi 12:00 ile 16:00 arası açık; küçük bir yerel pazar. ilanda yalnızca bu gün var, gitmeden önce kontrol edin.

sparks.why: Lystgården christmas market, Sat 5 Dec 2026 12:00 to 16:00, per a Fjord Norway listing; Visit Norway lists 5 and 6 Dec, so it may run Sunday too. Filed under flea as a stall market.
